name: Wave Runner
description: Explore sinusoidal wave dynamics by observing peak displacement, oscillation speed, and phase shifts.
learning_objective: Understand how frequency, intensity, and phase govern scalar wave outputs W(t) = I * sin(2*pi*f*t + phi).
mission: Adjust wave parameters to stabilize resonance and observe sinusoidal peak height.

name: Phase Shift
description: Compare two dynamic wave trajectories with angular phase displacements.
learning_objective: Learn phase displacement, periodic cycle alignment, and constructive/destructive trajectory comparison.
mission: Adjust phase angle phi to align wave peaks across cycles.

name: Chaos Race
description: Test trajectory sensitivity by introducing minute parameter perturbations.
learning_objective: Observe Master Stroke parameter sensitivity and measure trajectory divergence ratios over time steps.
mission: Tune chaos parameter c to observe trajectory divergence boundaries.

name: Particle Dance
description: Visualize multi-particle field evolution under continuous state vector dynamics.
learning_objective: Understand multi-particle field aggregation, mean state tracking, and polar projection coordinates.
mission: Observe particle radial dispersion under changing intensity.

name: Resonance Lab
description: Align oscillation frequencies between two state vectors and measure correlation.
learning_objective: Learn frequency matching, periodicity, and computational correlation metrics between state vectors.
mission: Find exact harmonic resonance frequency (f = 2.0 Hz).

name: Pattern Hunter
description: Identify numerical patterns and periodic trends in dynamic wave step sequences.
learning_objective: Explore numerical sequence analysis, trajectory range evaluation, and pattern prediction.
mission: Identify periodic oscillation trends across time steps.

name: State Transformer
description: Transform text losslessly through text -> numbers -> state -> decode pipeline.
learning_objective: Learn symbolic encoding, state representation, and lossless ASCII unicode reconstruction.
mission: Ensure state vector parameters allow perfect symbolic decoding.
